response.headline: Patient reports worsening breathlessness and shivers while RR and temperature trend upward

summary_points.text: Patient message at 12:00 reports more breathlessness walking to the bathroom than yesterday and feeling shivery.
NEWS2 is 0 at 13:00, but RR rose from 15 at 08:00 to 19 at 13:00.
Temperature rose from 36.7 at 08:00 to 37.9 at 13:00, just below the high limit of 38.0.
SpO2 has stayed 96 to 97 on air, above the 94 target, with no oxygen recorded.
Queue flagged for TREND and SYMPTOM_MESSAGE since 12:00, consistent with the rising trend and patient message.
Patient was stable at discharge planning and walked to the mailbox on 20 Nov; slept poorly due to cough on 21 Nov.

changes_vs_baseline.baseline: 95-96 on air at 19 Nov progress note

plan_rules.rule: NEWS2 urgent threshold 5 or any single parameter scoring 3

relevant_history.text: Feb 2025 left lower lobe pneumonia required 2 L/min oxygen for 3 days; low threshold for readmission noted.
Comorbidities include hypertension and type 2 diabetes; no COPD; no treatment limitations.
Lives with husband; on IV cefotaxime via portable elastomeric pump, pump changed at home visits.

suggested_actions.action: Consider contacting the patient now to assess current breathlessness, shivering and cough.
suggested_actions.rationale: Patient reports worsening breathlessness and shivers; trend is rising while scores remain under threshold.

suggested_actions.action: Consider repeating observations including SpO2 on exertion and a fresh set of vitals.
suggested_actions.rationale: SpO2 on exertion is not recorded and the RR and temperature trend needs confirmation.

suggested_actions.action: Consider reviewing whether bloods planned for day 5 should be brought forward.
suggested_actions.rationale: Latest bloods are not in the record; last CRP cited was 112 on 19 Nov.

suggested_actions.action: Consider escalation to on-call physician if the custom rule criteria are met.
suggested_actions.rationale: Custom rule covers NEWS2 of 5 or more, any single parameter of 3, SpO2 below 93 on air, or new oxygen need.
